label: Fixture User Engine
description: The fixture engine's USER VARIANT (lane engine-spi-egress L1b): scripts/fixtures/engine-plugin/server.js beside this manifest; its program is the one the owner names in its settings (executablePath), judged by VibeSpace, and its browser stays inside VibeSpace's allowlisting proxy (egressAllowlist).

settings.label: Program file
settings.description: The browser program this engine runs — the full path of a program on this computer. VibeSpace checks the file and measures its version before it runs it.

settings.label: Sites its browser may open
settings.description: Host names, comma separated (.example.test admits its sub-domains); every other site is refused by VibeSpace's proxy.
